sourcing_notes: The rate card states a single price per tier and names no enrollment or annual fee anywhere on the page. Both are recorded as sourced zeros rather than as unknowns, on the CorePower precedent.

Every per-class figure the studio prints reconciles exactly with its own plan maths — $148/4 = $37.00, $210/6 = $35.00, $256/8 = $32.00, $300/12 = $25.00 — so the figures are carried as stated rather than attributed or rounded.
The $99 four-class and $42 three-class offers are labelled introductory, so both are flagged promotional and neither derives the per-class figure.
